references.text: The Lord went ahead of the Israelites in a cloud pillar by day to show them the way, and in a fire pillar by night. This shows God's presence in the cloud pillar as a recurring theme.
The cloud pillar stood at the entrance of the tent when the Lord spoke with Moses, and the people worshiped. The same motif of the cloud pillar at the tent opening as a sign of God's presence.
The cloud covered the tabernacle sanctuary, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle. God's presence is manifested through the cloud over the sanctuary.
The Lord came down in a cloud pillar and stood at the entrance of the tent to speak to Aaron and Miriam. An identical description of God's revelation at the tent entrance.
The Lord goes ahead of the people in a cloud pillar by day. The cloud pillar as a symbol of God's guidance and presence among his people.
God spoke to them from the cloud pillar. A reference to God's communication with his people through the cloud.
